Is a player-season in a season with enough Opta coverage? (panna#221)

Source: R/psr.R
psr_season_covered.Rd

Returns a logical vector, one per row – a flag, not a filter. Opta's first seasons are sparse (2014: 822 matches with player stats against ~6,000 in a normal season), so one well-covered club tops any cross-season table. Pair with psr_leaderboard_eligible, which accepts this gate through its season_coverage argument so consumers need not know about it.

Usage

psr_season_covered(
  psr_dt,
  season_coverage,
  min_matches = MIN_MATCHES_PSR_SEASON
)

Arguments

psr_dt

Table containing season_end_year.

season_coverage

Table from psr_season_coverage.

min_matches

Minimum matches; defaults to MIN_MATCHES_PSR_SEASON.

Value

Logical vector.

Details

The latest season in season_coverage always passes: it can be in progress and so legitimately short, and the ramp-up seasons this gate exists for are never the latest. A season absent from the table, or an NA season, is NOT covered – unknown coverage cannot clear a coverage bar. An empty season_coverage, or one ending before the latest season in psr_dt, is an error: either means it was not built from the full match-stats table.
